jobs.description_text: Americans for Prosperity (AFP) is the premier grassroots organization focused on advocating solutions to the country’s greatest challenges. We recognize that tens of millions of Americans are frustrated with the extreme partisanship in government that keeps common-sense reforms from being passed, and instead seek to stand with policy leaders who are committed to finding a better way. Americans for Prosperity is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community. As Legislative Director for AFP-Ohio, you'll lead our work at the Ohio Statehouse, serving as our state government affairs lead and lobbyist. You'll track and shape legislation, build trusted relationships with lawmakers and coalition partners, and use AFP's grassroots strength to move policy forward. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000–$100,000 per year. This role may also be eligible for additional bonus compensation designed to align total compensation with an employee’s overall contribution to the organization.

As the Sales Enablement Director, you will build and build a comprehensive enablement strategy for our Development team, accelerating productivity, strengthening fundraising capabilities, and creating scalable onboarding and continuous learning programs that help our teams build meaningful, long-term partnerships. Reporting to the Head of Development Operations and leading the Development Enablement team, you will manage the Content Manager and Devo Compass Owner while helping shape the future structure of the enablement function. You will work closely with Development leadership, Partnership Advisor and Partnership Success Manager supervisors, content owners, Marketing, IT, and Development Operations. The ideal candidate combines significant experience in complex, consultative sales with a demonstrated ability to build learning programs, coach experienced sellers, and drive measurable performance improvements. Location: Arlington, VA For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $175,000-$225,000 per year. This role may also be eligible for additional bonus compensation designed to align total compensation with an employee’s overall contribution to the organization.

jobs.title: Senior Strategist
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Strategist on Stand Together’s Strategic Analysis team, you will be a trusted advisor to our issue teams on their hardest questions. Our team builds the research, insights, and standards behind our Priority Initiatives. These are the teams that lead our work on issues like Unleashing Economic Growth and Mobility and Bridging Divides. You will work embedded with one of them, from early strategy to finished materials. You will use research, our internal knowledge, and experts across the organization to build points of view and strategies. Then you will write them up so our staff and stakeholders can act on them. You will bring rigor to the issue leader’s hardest questions. The issue leader stays accountable for the strategy. This role fits a senior individual contributor who thinks like an advisor. You stay calm in ambiguity. You can turn a lot of data and information into one clear point of view. And you like helping other teams turn strategy into impact.

jobs.title: State Director, Texas
jobs.description_text: Americans for Prosperity (AFP) is the premier grassroots organization focused on advocating solutions to the country’s greatest challenges. We recognize that tens of millions of Americans are frustrated with the extreme partisanship in government that keeps common-sense reforms from being passed, and instead seek to stand with policy leaders who are committed to finding a better way. Americans for Prosperity is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community. The State Director, Texas is the senior leader of Americans for Prosperity, Texas (AFP-Texas) responsible for driving statewide public policy strategy, grassroots organizing, government affairs, and coalition engagement. You’ll also be the organization’s primary spokesperson in one of the nation’s most influential state capitals. You’ll lead a high-performing team and partner with legislators, donors, activists, coalition partners, and national stakeholders to win measurable policy change at the local, state, and federal levels. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $150,000–$200,000 per year. In addition to base salary, additional bonus earnings may represent a meaningful portion of total compensation. Total compensation will align with an employee’s overall contribution and the value created for the organization. We believe incentives matter. Consistent with this approach, compensation may vary within or outside of the anticipated range based on these considerations.

jobs.title: Index Analyst Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text: About Syntax Data Syntax LLC is a financial data and technology company that codifies business models into a relational system we call Affinity Data™. Syntax operates through three segments: Affinity Data™, Syntax Direct™, and Syntax Indices™. Using its patented FIS® technology inspired by systems sciences, the Affinity Data™ segment offers comprehensive, granular product-line revenue data. Syntax Direct™ uses this data to facilitate the creation and ongoing management of direct indexing solutions and rules-based equity portfolios through an automated platform. Syntax Indices™ offers customized and proprietary indices, including core global benchmarks, thematic, smart beta, defined outcome, and target volatility indices. These indices serve as the foundation for a range of financial products, including ETFs, UITs, and structured products. About the Role The Index Intern will support our team by assisting with the research, creation, and development of market indices.

jobs.description_text: AHEAD’s Specialist Solutions Engineers are the technical experts that collaborate with our AHEAD account teams to help identify, qualify, and build solutions that support our customer’s Digital Business transformation. The AHEAD Network Specialist Solutions Engineer (SSE) will be focused on Networking technologies. A core tenet and base requirement for this position is mastery of Cisco Route/Switch and/or Datacenter technologies. Outside of this core tenet, our expectation is to attract, recruit and attain resources who have a desire to focus not only on traditional on-premises Cisco solutions, but also to be looking to career, technology and skill advancement by being actively willing to demonstrate skills and ability to learn new technologies including multiple SDN solutions, network security, load balancing, edge / acceleration, and cloud technologies. Understanding that the impetus and impact of Cloud computing is real and should be incorporated into solutions is key. Experience or eagerness to learn about and with network and system / access design with Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure or other cloud services is a key requirement. The SSE is considered a subject matter expert in these areas with responsibility for selling and designing complex solutions. The SSE is also considered an organizational thought leader for their specialty area.

You will collaborate with internal teams and clients and may travel on-site to support rack delivery and installation.

ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale's need to detect and respond to security events across its production and corporate environments is growing as the company scales. We're looking for a Senior Detection and Response Engineer to own detection engineering and to lead incident response when it counts, coordinating the response and driving it to resolution. This is a high-ownership role with real room to shape how detection and response works at Anyscale. You will own the detection pipeline, the response runbooks, and incident response, reporting to the Head of Security and partnering with engineering. This role is based in India. jobs.description_text: About the role: Anyscale is looking for an engineering leader to manage the open source Ray Data team. Ray Data https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/data/data.html is the Python-native data processing engine for AI workloads on Ray. It handles multimodal and structured data and powers batch inference, data loading for distributed training, and large-scale preprocessing. The team owns the open source library end to end, including: - The streaming execution engine, including scheduling, backpressure, and resource management across CPUs and GPUs - Batch inference for LLMs and multimodal models, including integrations with inference engines such as vLLM - Data loading for production training workloads with Ray Train and popular ML frameworks - Connectors for data sources and formats such as Parquet, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Lance, and cloud object storage - Performance, stability, and fault tolerance at large scale This is a first-line engineering management role where you'll lead a team of engineers, stay involved in technical design and code, and own the team's roadmap within the open source project. Ray Data has a large and active community, so you'll also work closely with external contributors to review designs, guide technical direction, and support the project's continued growth and success. jobs.description_text: The Bid Coordinator is the organizational backbone of the bid team. Working alongside Bid Managers and Bid Specialists, this role makes sure every bid runs to a rigorous, well-managed process, so that deadlines are met, contributors know what is expected of them, and nothing falls through the cracks. jobs.title: AI-First Engineering Intern
jobs.description_text: Why This Role Exists Xsolla is going all-in on becoming an AI-first company, and we're not waiting for a slow rollout to get there. We're offering AI Engineer Internships in regions across the globe to help drive that shift directly, not by sitting in the back office, but by building. You'll work on two things: Internal AI initiatives – helping unlock AI tooling and integrations across Xsolla faster than our existing teams can alone. Proof-of-concept builds on our own APIs – showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. This isn't a shadow-and-observe internship. You'll ship code that goes to customers – internal teams or external players and game developers – working closely with senior engineers and fellow interns across our global regions. Who You'll Work With You won't be isolated on an intern-only project island. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. That combination is the point: senior engineers give you a bar for what production-grade, customer-facing code looks like, and your fellow interns give you a peer group to trade ideas, code, and AI workflows every week.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK, our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

jobs.description_text: About the Role This is a full-time, 12-month program at our Berlin HQ for people who want to understand AI rather than just use it. It begins where our product meets the real world: customer support. Many support tickets are a small puzzle about how large language models and cloud software behave in production. Why did the same prompt give two different answers? Why did a long document get cut off? Why is one model fast today and slow tomorrow? Why did an agent call the wrong tool? Why did an API integration time out? You will be the person who works out what is actually going on and explains it clearly. For most of your first year, the support queue is your home base and your classroom. Few jobs expose you to as many real AI systems, real enterprise environments, and real failure modes, every single day. The purpose of the year: by month twelve, you should understand our platform and operations deeply, from the chat interface down to the models and infrastructure behind it. A Langdock business team should want to hire you permanently, and you should have found the work that energizes you most. What You Will Learn to Understand Customers ask the questions that the rest of the world is still figuring out. jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description_text: About Boltz Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible. Boltz was founded by former MIT scientists who created Boltz-1, the first fully commercially available open-source model to approach AlphaFold 3-level accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes. We focus on two things: Foundation models. Our open models, Boltz-1, Boltz-2 and BoltzGen, are trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations. Our latest proprietary foundation models power our products and the custom models we build with partners. Boltz Lab and the Boltz API. Our products run our latest models, design pipelines (BoltzMol for small molecules, BoltzProt for protein design) and agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules in Boltz Lab, run our models from their own code and agents through the Boltz API, or deploy them inside their own environment. The two feed each other: our open releases earn scientific credibility and community insight, and our products turn our full range of models into real impact for partners including Pfizer, Takeda, GSK, Bristol
